name: mmg-visualizemm
description: 面向数学建模新手的「AI 辅助读题 + 自主建模」辅导工具（开源自托管 + BYOK）

scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.config.js
scripts.check:syntax: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const {join}=require('node:path');const files=fs.readdirSync('server').filter(name=>name.endsWith('.js')).sort();if(!files.length){console.error('no server/*.js files');process.exit(1)}for(const name of files){const file=join('server',name);console.log('check '+file);const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',file],{stdio:'inherit'});if(result.status)process.exit(result.status)}"
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run check:syntax && npm run build
